title: Independent reading: Matthew 6:9–13
subtitle: Read a sequence of imperatives and purpose-oriented petitions.
overview: The prayer is organized by direct address followed by linked petitions. Mark the imperatives and subjunctives instead of treating the prayer as undivided devotional vocabulary.
Notice how pronouns and repeated second-person forms preserve the address to the Father while first-person plurals shape communal petitions.

items.grc: ἁγιασθήτω τὸ ὄνομά σου· ἐλθέτω ἡ βασιλεία σου.
items.en: May your name be sanctified; may your kingdom come.

items.grc: δὸς ἡμῖν σήμερον τὸν ἄρτον ἡμῶν τὸν ἐπιούσιον.
items.en: Give us today our daily bread.
